symbolDescription:
The formatting that applies to the current selection.

A value-carrying mark is `null` when the selection is mixed, so a toolbar can render
an indeterminate state rather than lying about one of the values.

optionDescriptions.marks: Inline formatting; a value mark is `null` when the selection is mixed.
optionDescriptions.block: The block the caret is in, and how it is laid out.
optionDescriptions.list: The list the caret is in, if any, and how deeply nested it is.
optionDescriptions.link: The link the caret is inside, or `null`.
optionDescriptions.canUndo: Whether there is anything to undo, which disables the control.
optionDescriptions.canRedo: Whether there is anything to redo.
optionDescriptions.isEmpty: Whether the document is empty in the `isEmpty` sense (fixes R2).
optionDescriptions.isCollapsed: Whether the selection is a caret rather than a range.
